name: TTS-1 HD
description: OpenAI's high-definition text-to-speech model producing higher quality audio output.

metadata.Voices: alloy, echo, fable, onyx, nova, shimmer

text.description: The text to generate audio for. Maximum length is 4096 characters.

voice.description: The voice to use when generating the audio. Defaults to alloy.

response_format.description: The output format for the audio. Supported formats are mp3, opus, wav, aac and flac.

speed.description: The speed of the generated audio. Select a value from 0.25 to 4.0. 1.0 is the default.

audio.description: URL to the generated audio file

input.text: Hello! Welcome to Cloudflare AI Gateway. Let me show you what we can do.
Once upon a time, in a kingdom beyond the clouds, there lived a young inventor who dreamed of building machines that could think.

So here's the thing about large language models — they're not actually thinking. They're predicting the next token based on patterns in their training data. But the results can be surprisingly coherent.
